text:
alex: Heads up — I'm drafting a PRD for a 'Tenancy evolution' initiative: routing policy changes, multi-region isolation, and clearer launch criteria. Putting a rough doc in Drive: https://drive.redwood/example (WIP). Sync Thurs 10am?

mira: @alex putting it on my calendar. can you call out which customers pushed this? sales asked for clearer isolation lanes. 

devon: linking the customer list — finance + healthcare pilots. Data residency + KMS are hard constraints for them. 

sam: For rollout I'd suggest: 1) pilot with 2 tenants in dedicated slice; 2) canary with regional routing; 3) full launch. Need clear KPI gates for each step (latency, cost delta, failed requests). 

julia: +1. propose KPIs: 95p latency (<150ms extra), <10% cost increase, <0.5% error spike. If we exceed any, pause rollout. 

alex: good. also need to define fallback policy: if isolation slice overloaded, fallback to compatible model variant in same region, not cross-region. want to avoid data egress. 

devon: agree. maybe a policy matrix: 
```
policy: regional_isolation
fallback: model_variant_same_region
eviction_threshold: 85%
``` 

mira: can we make fallback configurable per-tenant? enterprise customers will want opt-out. 

alex: yes, per-tenant opt-out flag. must show in Console and in API. add to PRD. 

ops-bot: Calendar event created by alex: Tenancy evolution sync — Thu 10:00 — #product 

sam: question — how do we measure 'tenant isolation' objectively? is it just resource contention or also noisy-neighbor output quality? 

julia: both. measure SLOs (latency/error), and run prompt-evals periodically to catch regressions. tie regressions to rollbacks. 

alex: action items: 1) i'll update PRD with KPI gates + fallback matrix; 2) devon to draft KMS/data residency checklist; 3) eng to propose implementation spike for per-tenant routing flags. sync Thurs 10. 

mira: noted. I'll invite security and sales to the sync. 

devon: will drop a short spike doc by tomorrow EOD with rough timeline and rough estimate. 

sam: will draft canary playbook and rollback commands. 

julia: adding eval plan to PRD. 

alex: thanks — short thread but solid. :thumbsup:
